title: Repair a door caption
prompt: `caption` takes a `Door`. A locked door returns its `reason` exactly, even empty text. An open door returns `"Open"`. Fix the type error in the starter so the function is safe for both shapes.
hints: The error points at a field that only one shape of `Door` has.
checks: caption({ kind: "locked", reason: "Key is with Lee" }) === "Key is with Lee"

wrongAnswers.misconception: Treats an empty reason as an open door.

feedback: The error points at a field that only one shape of `Door` has.
